condition_map.B: fault with the gate closed and data fresh
condition_map.C: matched fault with the gate open
condition_map.D: condition B evaluated under policy P1 (freshness fallback)
condition_map.E: condition B evaluated under policy P2 (support-aware)
condition_map.F: positive control -- the occlusion forced into the decision window. For heading_course this is a real flight regime (armed, airborne, hovering). For armed_gate_pair it is PHYSICALLY INCONSISTENT and labelled as such.
condition_map.G: matched control for F -- the same short fault at a moment when the gate is OPEN. Added during the development phase after F alone was found to confound fault duration with gate state.

seed_varies: sensor noise only; generate_flight is scripted and its seed argument has no effect, by its own docstring
